mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.alarm_code AS alarmCode, m.module_name AS moduleName, m.abnormal_type_id AS abnormalTypeId, m.alarm_level_id AS alarmLevelId, m.alarm_time AS alarmTime, m.server_info AS serverInfo, m.alarm_status_id AS alarmStatusId, m.check_reason AS checkReason, m.repair_voucher AS repairVoucher, m.repair_time AS repairTime, m.remark, m.reserve1, m.reserve2, m.creator, m.updater, m.deleted, m.create_time AS createTime, m.update_time AS updateTime, a.typename AS abnormalName, g.typename AS alarmLevelName, s.typename AS alarmStatusName FROM module_alarm_record m LEFT JOIN abnormal_type a ON m.abnormal_type_id = a.id LEFT JOIN alarm_grade g ON m.alarm_level_id = g.id LEFT JOIN alarm_status s ON m.alarm_status_id = s.id WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.id = #{id}
